# Damalga

> Systems builder and creative web coder based in Madrid, Spain. 7 years of front-end development experience with a background in graphic design. Focus on efficient, clean and maintainable systems: reusable components (Vue, React), pixel-perfect UI, careful DOM management, and hands-on comfort with GNU/Linux, self-hosting and networking.

Damalga is the personal site of Damián — an acronym of his full name. The homepage is an interactive résumé covering education, work experience, projects, tools and interests. English is the site language; Spanish and English are spoken.

## About

- [Home](https://damalga.com): Interactive résumé and portfolio
